finding_text: No deficiencies were recorded.
finding_text_ko: 기록된 결함사항(deficiency)이 없었다.

finding_text: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The importer and/or the distributor's compliance with the current master production documents and/or the marketing authorization was inadequate. The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 수입자 및/또는 유통자가 현행 마스터 제조문서(master production documents) 및/또는 판매허가(marketing authorization)를 준수하는지에 대한 관리가 부적절했다. 완제품 출하 승인을 위한 평가가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 의약품의 지속 안정성 프로그램(ongoing stability program)이 부적절했다.

finding_text: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속 조치가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.
finding_text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항을 적절히 문서화, 평가 및/또는 승인하도록 보장하기에 부적절했다.

finding_text: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 불만(complaint) 및/또는 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 기타 정보의 평가, 기록, 후속 조치 및/또는 조사가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate. The company did not adequately validate the analytical test procedures used in the stability program.
finding_text_ko: 의약품의 지속 안정성 프로그램(ongoing stability program)이 부적절했다. 회사는 안정성 프로그램에 사용되는 분석 시험법을 적절히 밸리데이션(validation)하지 않았다.

finding_text: The qualification and/or verification of utilities and/or support systems was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 유틸리티 및/또는 지원 시스템의 적격성평가(qualification) 및/또는 검증(verification)이 부적절했다.

finding_text: The evaluation was inadequate for cases where there was a deviation from the norm and/or where products were on the borderline of the acceptable range.
finding_text_ko: 기준에서 벗어난 경우 및/또는 제품이 허용 범위의 경계선(borderline)에 있는 경우에 대한 평가가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The examination and/or approval of fabrication, packaging, labelling, testing, storage, and/or the transportation method and procedures by the person in charge of the quality control department before implementation was inadequate. The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate. The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 품질관리 부서 책임자가 제조(fabrication), 포장, 표시(labelling), 시험, 보관 및/또는 운송 방법과 절차를 시행 전에 검토 및/또는 승인하는 것이 부적절했다. 기준일탈(out-of-specification) 시험 결과의 조사, 처리 및/또는 보고가 부적절했다. 불만(complaint) 및/또는 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 기타 정보의 평가, 기록, 후속 조치 및/또는 조사가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to prevent contamination.
finding_text_ko: 시설(premises)이 오염을 방지하도록 설계, 건설, 운영 및/또는 유지되지 않았다.

finding_text: The monitoring procedures for microbial and/or environmental conditions were inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 미생물 및/또는 환경 조건에 대한 모니터링 절차가 부적절했다.

finding_text: Confirmatory testing was not performed by an alternate laboratory.
finding_text_ko: 대체 시험실(alternate laboratory)에서 확인시험(confirmatory testing)을 수행하지 않았다.

finding_text: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성, 유지, 처리 및/또는 검토가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 공급자, 제조자(fabricator), 시험자, 포장자, 표시자(labeller), 유통자, 수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질협정서(quality agreement)의 구비, 내용 및/또는 유지가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.
finding_text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하기에 지침 및/또는 절차가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 기준일탈(out-of-specification) 시험 결과의 조사, 처리 및/또는 보고가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The evidence used to demonstrate the transportation and/or storage conditions of each lot or batch of the drug was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 의약품 각 로트 또는 배치(lot or batch)의 운송 및/또는 보관 조건을 입증하는 데 사용된 근거가 부적절했다.

finding_text: Complete testing was not performed according to the requirements.
finding_text_ko: 요구사항에 따른 전체 시험(complete testing)을 수행하지 않았다.

finding_text: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.
finding_text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항을 적절히 문서화, 평가 및/또는 승인하도록 보장하기에 부적절했다.

finding_text: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속 조치가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 불만(complaint) 및/또는 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 기타 정보의 평가, 기록, 후속 조치 및/또는 조사가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The maintenance of evidence was inadequate for manufacturing, packaging, labelling, required testing, storage, and/or distribution, including the respective conditions.
finding_text_ko: 제조, 포장, 표시(labelling), 필수 시험, 보관 및/또는 유통에 대해 각각의 조건을 포함한 근거(evidence)의 유지가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 회수(recall)에 관한 서면 절차가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 부적절했다.
